title: What Are Vertices, Faces and Edges? Full Table, Euler's Formula and Curved Solids
seoTitle: Vertices, Faces and Edges: Table, Euler's Formula, Examples
seoDescription: Vertices, faces and edges explained with a full table for prisms and pyramids, the n-sided shortcut, Euler's formula checks and the cylinder-cone trap.
excerpt: Count any prism or pyramid in seconds with the n-sided shortcut, check your answers with Euler's formula, learn when it fails, and see how NCERT treats cylinders, cones and spheres.
